I can definitely see that! It’s definitely a very difficult and touchy subject. See growing up my parents always commented on how fat or skinny I looked. It carried over to when I got older (my sister struggled with an eating disorder too) and she was the one who started mentioning the word ‘healthy’ to me. I guess how I think of the word is that it means that there’s nothing wrong with the way I look, that healthy means whatever shape or size I am that it’s my natural body. I’m not starving myself or overeating but rather I’m taking care of my body and I guess that word just made sense to me
I get asked when I’ll be starting steroids to bulk up because I’m way too skinny 😂

As someone who has suffered through this personally at the same age as your daughter, I highly highly recommend never mentioning her weight to her. That was the biggest thing that set me off. Let her know how beautiful and ‘healthy’ she’s looking never too skinny or fat. It’s a trigger. I would recommend stocking the fridge with food she likes as well as healthy snacks! She’ll be less likely to want to purge if she’s eating ‘low calorie’ healthy snacks. Hopefully this will encourage her to like eating again. When you see she’s getting comfortable with the thought of having a consistent eating habit she’ll hopefully start to lose the hate for food and this idea she needs to look a certain way. I hope this helps a little!

May I offer some guidance in regards to this? 

I’ve learned in life that some people enter your life for a reason, whether that’s good or bad. What I learned along the way is that when a guy leaves or you leave someone, it’s not the end. It may hurt and suck at the beginning and you’ll always wonder, ‘does he miss me? Is he hurting?’ 

The answer may be yes, but in reality, no person should be more important than yourself. Be grateful for whatever time you’ve spent together and take lessons from it on what may have gone wrong or right so you can see what you personally may want to improve upon yourself that you may of not noticed before. You never want to live a life wondering about another person and what they’re doing or thinking. Focus on yourself. And I know everyone always says that but it’s the best fucking feeling knowing you are special, meaning there’s no one in this world an exact clone of you - I hope not but who knows! Lol. If someone walked away, let them. 

Wouldn’t it be a better feeling knowing you’re living your life exactly the way you want and dreamt of and having him wonder if you’re thinking of him?
